Story: Saudi Arabia's Digital Experience Maturity Rises to 87%
Verified angle: During LEAP 2026, the Digital Government Authority (DGA) announced the results of Saudi Arabia's Digital Experience Maturity Index for 2026, which achieved an "Advanced" maturity level with a score of 87.06%. The comprehensive assessment evaluated 59 digital platforms, up from 50 in 2025, across four main perspectives: beneficiary satisfaction, user experience, complaints handling, and technologies and tools. Over 805,500 people participated in the "Evaluate Your Digital Experience" survey, a significant increase from 374,000 the previous year. The Absher platform topped the rankings with a score of 94.38%, followed closely by Etimad (94.36%), Senaei (92.83%), Balady (92.56%), and Tawakkalna (92.50%). The Digital Inclusion sub-index also reached 76.98%, reflecting efforts to design accessible services for all segments of society, including persons with disabilities and the elderly. This announcement highlights Saudi Arabia's continued progress in digital transformation, aligning with Vision 2030 objectives and solidifying its global position in digital government.
Principal organizations or institutions: Digital Government Authority, Absher, Etimad, Senaei.
Relevant people for editorial context only: Ahmed bin Mohammed Alsuwaiyan.
